ad_info.reference_style: Clean DTC comparison-table ad: a raised, brand-colored column with the product and check marks next to a muted grey generic column with crosses

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium beauty-supplement comparison table on a deep magenta background, the black-and-fuchsia bottle crowning the winning column.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Clear, confident and logical; readable in two seconds.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded table columns, white check marks in bubblegum pink circles, muted X marks in grey circles, hairline dividers.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (heavy, uppercase) for the headline and headers, Poppins SemiBold for row labels.

creative_objective: Explain why someone who took plain aguaje saw no results: this formula adds fenogreco, maca negra and vitamins A and E in one bottle, and the brand column wins at a glance.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline. 2) The raised hot fuchsia column with the bottle on top. 3) Checks vs. crosses. 4) Row labels.
art_direction.composition_style: Structured three-column table under a centered headline, spanning about 88% of the width: row labels on the left (about 40%), the brand column in the middle (about 30%), the generic column on the right (about 30%). The brand column is taller, raised and carries the product as its header. Frontal view, product seen slightly from above.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 6-19% height. Column headers about 22-48%. Rows about 50-93%, four equal rows with hairline dividers across the label and generic columns. Brand column 20-95% height; generic column 26-93%. Icons centered in their cells. 6% margins.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat graphic table; the brand column has a soft drop shadow to look raised; the bottle has studio light, a crisp highlight and a soft contact shadow; the generic column and its bottle are flat, desaturated and low-contrast.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a deep magenta background. A bold headline centered at the top. Below, a comparison table with 4 rows: row labels on the left; in the middle a tall raised hot fuchsia column topped by the user's bottle and a short header label, with a check in every row; on the right a shorter flat grey column topped by a plain unbranded grey supplement bottle and a short header label, with a cross in every row. Hairline dividers separate the rows.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Quiet base that lets the table read cleanly
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Flat deep magenta #B0105E with a very soft darker vignette
White bold question in max 2 lines, key words in bubblegum pink

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Crowns the user's product as the winner
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Tall rounded hot fuchsia #E6177F rectangle with a thin white edge glow and soft drop shadow

detected_visual_blocks.position: Header of the brand column, 20-24% height, no wider than 22% of the canvas
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The user's bottle exactly as in the attached photo, seen slightly from above, top breaking slightly above the column edge
Flat dark grey rounded rectangle, no shadow

detected_visual_blocks.position: Header of the generic column, 14-17% height
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: A plain unbranded grey supplement bottle with a blank label, no readable text, desaturated, flat light

detected_visual_blocks.position: One per row in each column
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: White checks in bubblegum pink circles in the brand column; muted red-grey X marks in light grey circles in the generic column, all the same size
Four short white labels with low-contrast hairline dividers

forbidden_additions: Price tags, discount, offer or urgency badges
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Icons other than the check and cross marks
Real competitor brands, logos or recognizable packaging
More than 4 rows or a third compared option

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement comparison ad on a flat deep magenta background (#B0105E) with a very soft darker vignette, frontal view. TOP CENTER (6-19 percent of the height): a bold uppercase headline in two lines, white, with the key words in bubblegum pink (#FF8CC0). BELOW: a three-column comparison table spanning about 88 percent of the width with four equal rows. LEFT COLUMN (about 40 percent of the table width): four short row labels in white semi-bold, left-aligned at the 6 percent margin, one per row, separated by thin low-contrast hairline dividers that run across the label and generic columns and pass behind the brand column. MIDDLE COLUMN: a tall rounded hot fuchsia (#E6177F) rectangle running from about 20 to 95 percent of the height, with a thin soft white edge glow and a soft drop shadow so it looks raised and clearly taller than the other column; at its top, seen slightly from above, with its top breaking slightly above the column edge and no wider than the column: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. Studio light, crisp highlight, soft contact shadow. Directly below the bottle a short white bold header label. Then in each of the four rows a white check mark inside a small bubblegum pink circle, centered. RIGHT COLUMN: a shorter flat dark grey rounded rectangle from about 26 to 93 percent of the height, no shadow; at its top a plain unbranded grey plastic supplement bottle with a blank grey label and no readable text, desaturated and flat-lit; below it a short mid-grey header label; then in each row a muted red-grey X inside a small light grey circle, centered, same size as the checks. Include only these elements and texts.

text_layers.text_style: Poppins Black uppercase, each line about 6-7% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, centered, white with 'O 3 EXTRACTOS EN 1?' in bubblegum pink

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the top of the brand column, below the product
text_layers.text_style: Poppins Bold uppercase, about 3-3.5% of the canvas height, 1 line, white
Poppins Medium uppercase, same size as the brand header, 1 line, mid-grey
Poppins SemiBold, about 3.5% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, left-aligned, white

mandatory_visual_elements: Tall, raised hot fuchsia column topped by the real product bottle from the attached photo
Flat dark grey generic column topped by a plain unbranded grey supplement bottle
Check marks in every row of the brand column and crosses in every row of the generic column
final_generation_exclusions: No readable text, logo or brand on the generic bottle
No people, fruits, capsules or lifestyle props
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia), perfectly spelled with accents.
